√pru 'flow'
present: [1.] právate etc. 
perfect: pupruve etc. 
aorist: [4.] proṣṭhās 
verbal: prutá 
derivatives: pravá pravaṇá V.+ -prut V.B. 
A side-form to the much more common √plu.

√pruth 'snort'
present: [1.] próthati etc. próthamāna 
[perfect: puprotha puprothe aprothīt aprothiṣṭa prothiṣyati prothiṣyate -prothitā ]
verbal: -prúthya prothya 
secondary: intensive: pópruthat -- causative: prothayitvā 
derivatives: protha B.+ prothátha RV.

√pruṣ 'sprinkle'
present: [5.] pruṣṇuvánti pruṣṇávat pruṣṇute -- [9.] pruṣṇánt -- [6.] pruṣa pruṣánt? -- [4.] ápruṣyat 
[perfect: puproṣa aproṣīt ]
future: [1.] proṣiṣyánt -- [2.] proṣitā 
verbal: pruṣitá 
derivatives: -pruṣ V.+ -prūṣ TS. pruṣvā AV.B. pṛ́ṣvā? TS. 
Compare √pluṣ.
